record.title: Santa Rosa–Chacalluta renewed migrant road blockade, June 22, 2023
record.scope: Road between Chacalluta and Santa Rosa at the international boundary, on the Chilean side
record.crossings: Santa Rosa–Chacalluta / Línea de la Concordia
record.direction: Peru-bound lanes expressly identified; broader vehicle queue also reported.
record.movement: Vehicles on the international road, notably shared taxis; Emol identifies Peru-bound lanes.
record.exceptions: No verified whole-frontier ban; the separate denial of admission to undocumented protesters continued after traffic resumed.
record.enforcement: Migrants occupied road lanes; Chilean Carabineros restored traffic.
record.consequences: Vehicles queued and drivers argued with protesters.
record.relationship: Promotes the June component of R3-AM-L010. Distinct recurrence from R3-AM-010/011 in April; Radio Uno explicitly reports no renewed blockade between the prior encampment and June 22.
record.status_observation: Status limited to dated evidence; no claim of present closure.
record.official_rationale: Protesters demanded permission to enter Peru and continue their journey.
record.context: A renewed roadside protest after the earlier April–May migrant encampment had dispersed.
record.uncertainty: Radio Uno reports a short action of almost twenty minutes; Emol independently confirms the date and reopened road but not that duration. Clock times are reported differently on the two sides and are not harmonized here.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. Same-day brief closure. Radio Uno reports almost twenty minutes, without independent minute-level corroboration; no computed interval.
